title: MIDI keyboard
ask: Turning this on asks your browser to let Fermatina hear the keys you play on a MIDI keyboard; what you play never leaves this device.
none: No MIDI keyboard is connected. Plug one in and Fermatina hears it straight away.
denied: Your browser did not allow it, so Fermatina cannot hear a MIDI keyboard. You can change this in your browser’s settings for this site.
error: Your browser could not connect to the MIDI keyboard. Turn this setting on again to try once more.
unsupported: This browser cannot use a MIDI keyboard. Chrome, Edge or Opera on a computer, or Chrome on Android, can.
soundBlocked: Click or tap the page once so Fermatina can sound what you play.
